body: Resume note, The Criminal Mind. Ziggy held all character generation until the casting call completes and opened a set-only round instead (no people, no hands); he gave his go in the Pent House and the Chief of Staff set a cap of 300 stills, batch 1 the car (Z_10), the bathroom (Z_7), the bedroom (Z_8), batch 2 to each set's original maker. Attached: the shot map delta v002 (your take-1 cards are not edited; 202 card-text corrections wait for you in the TSV's cardTextCorrections column; 8 under-splits and 33 inserts add sub-shot and insert ids beside your shot ids, which are unchanged), the set camera maps (the writer's choices for the car's identity, the matched bathroom and bedroom looks and the bullpen geometry are labelled defaults), and the project's decisions record. Baldadoon chose HENDERSON-EXTERIOR-L03 as the house. What waits on you: the binding of returned set images to shots (11.2 rows by position), the card corrections, and the era and agency rulings when Baldadoon answers B and K. Nothing was generated by the writer; the team generates on Ziggy's go.
